pr_title: Add Hue manual bridge config flow + options flow
pr_body:
<!--

## Breaking change
<!--
  If your PR contains a breaking change for existing users, it is important
  to tell them what breaks, how to make it work again and why we did this.
  This piece of text is published with the release notes, so it helps if you
  write it towards our users, not us.
  Note: Remove this section if this PR is NOT a breaking change.
-->

Configuring a Hue bridge via YAML configuration is now deprecated. Your current YAML configuration is imported and can be safely removed after upgrading.

Adding Hue bridges manually by IP can now be done via the UI. Changing allowing Hue groups or unreachable Hue bulb is now managed by clicking the options button on the Hue integration in the UI.


## Proposed change
<!-- 
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->

This PR adds the possibility to define a manual Hue bridge that is not discovered via the config flow and adds an options flow to manage the allow Hue groups and unreachable Hue bulbs config options.

This removes the need to have YAML configuration for the Hue integration, and thus that one is now marked deprecated.

What do you think is the approximate ETA for this feature to go live in an update?

@juddweiss It is a new feature, so the next main release (new features are never in bugfix releases): 0.113.

Hey there @balloob, mind taking a look at this pull request as its been labeled with an integration (`hue`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L181) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Do you have an approximate ETA on when this feature will go live in 0.113? 
I'm still paying for my Nabu Casa account, but my home assistant setup isn't working, and I'm waiting on this feature to get everything working again.
Thank you again for being pro-active and figuring out a solution!

@juddweiss Our release schedule is listed on <https://developers.home-assistant.io/>

Furthermore, I want to emphasize that Home Assistant and its integrations are freely available, and therefore not part of the Nabu Casa account. The Nabu Casa subscription gives access to the Home Assistant Cloud services, which the Hue integration isn't related to.

Thank you Frenk, Wednesday isn't too far away. Awesome!
You're right, though a Nabu Casa account is the only way to get the Hue Integration working with Alexa.
I should explore other Home Assistant functionality, I know the sea is vast, but managing rooms on multiple hue hubs through Alexa is literally the only single thing I use Home Assistant for. I can't wait to get that functionality back, so my 5 roommates can fully control their lights again.

I appreciate everything you're doing.

IT'S WORKING! I'm so happy!
THANK YOU!!!

Seriously Frenck, thank you so much for taking the initiative to fix this problem. 
It feels so glorious to see my Home Assistant discover my Hue Rooms again. Months of frustration has melted away. And now I've got multiple Hue bridges working with Alexa again, and everyone in the house can control their lights with their voice. 
Now anything is possible!
The world is a better place, due to you.
Thank you thank you

(On a side note, after the update yesterday, I ran into some frustration. After the update, I was elated when I saw the Rooms show up as entities on Home Assistant again, but Alexa would NOT discover anything, no matter what. I was pulling my hair out all night, and decided to sleep on it before I go on a killing spree. This morning I was searching for reasons why Alexa wouldn't discover Home Assistant integrated devices, and I came across a Home Assistant Community thread that mentioned a bug that if you integrated a Denon receiver, Alexa won't discover anything. How random. I did in fact integrate my Denon receiver the other day, but I hadn't done anything with it. Removing the receiver from integrations didn't fix the issue. So an hour ago I pulled the micro SD card from my Raspberry Pi, wiped it and re-flashed Home Assistant with a fresh install. Created new integrations for my other hubs..... and it still didn't work. But then I clicked "Sync Entities" in the Alexa section of Home Assistant Cloud... and Alexa discovered my Rooms! The Rooms are responding perfectly to voice. I'm pinching myself, but it's true!)

## The problem

Home Assistant no longer discovers Rooms or Zones upon creating a Philips Hue Integration, no matter what I do or add to the Configuration.YAML

Managing rooms with Alexa from multiple Philips Hue hubs is literally the only reason I purchased a subscription to Nabu Casa cloud. I'm spending days and pulling my hair out trying to get this to work again. I'm frustrated. My house is not working properly without this feature. Can you PLEASE return the ability for Home Assistant to easily discover rooms when creating an integration?

I've added the following to my configuration.yaml but it makes no difference:
hue:
bridges:
- host: 192.168.68.83
allow_unreachable: true
allow_hue_groups: true
- host: 192.168.68.87
allow_unreachable: true

review_comments: An clean up would be to move the three entry update calls out of the if blocks to a single call that is done if there's data or options to update.

Yeah, I have tried that, but because there are multiple dicts modified here (and copied) and items are added and removed... the code becomes really unreadable and actually bigger as well.

Since the lower part of the YAML stuff is going to be removed in a few versions, 2 cases will be left and those are only conditionally triggered once.

So I wrote it this way on purpose, to keep it simple and readable now.
